features.summary: The ML pipeline changes move away from using the Origin Private File System (OPFS), browser-managed storage used for model files, from workers, and clean up its supporting code. They also add an `/answer` route for web searches, allowing the feature to request answer-style results. These changes make the storage and search paths more dependable without changing the underlying ML concepts.

features.summary: The tests now check how OPFS behaves when downloading models, using a dedicated hidden browser frame for that storage work, and restore tests that also pass under ThreadSanitizer (TSan), a tool for finding concurrency bugs. They also make the `ml.llama.hwInference` setting follow Firefox’s release cycle, helping ensure the hardware-inference option and its tests stay aligned with shipped versions.

features.summary: The ML tests now exercise llama.cpp, the engine used for language-model inference, across both host-process and hardware-inference paths, including concurrency, cancellation, and process failure. New performance tests measure complete ML scenarios and report shared metrics, while ONNX backend selection and availability checks are made more consistent. This gives the team broader evidence that inference works reliably and performs well across configurations.

They also add an `/answer` route for web searches, allowing the feature to request answer-style results; a documentation markup fix keeps the related docs build working.

features.label: Page extractor

patches.author: Taimur Hasan
patches.subject: Report a headless load redirected off-site as a distinguishable block, not a generic timeout

patches.author: Taimur Hasan
patches.subject: PageExtractor telemetry bypasses OHTTP and includes automatic client metadata

patches.author: Taimur Hasan
patches.subject: Add page_extractor.phase Glean event as the twin of the PageExtractor profiler marker

patches.author: Taimur Hasan
patches.subject: Add profiler markers to PageExtractor

patches.author: Taimur Hasan
patches.subject: Enable YouTube transcript extraction in PageExtractor by default

features.summary: PageExtractor, Firefox’s tool for extracting content from web pages, can now extract YouTube transcripts by default. Its performance and phases are also easier to monitor, and its telemetry includes client metadata while bypassing Oblivious HTTP (OHTTP), a privacy relay; headless page loads redirected off-site are now reported as blocked rather than as generic timeouts.

features.label: llama.cpp (vendored)

patches.author: Sylvestre Ledru
patches.subject: Declare every about:license notice in moz.build

patches.author: Paul Adenot
patches.subject: Don't attempt to use Metal in the Inference content process.

patches.author: Paul Adenot
patches.subject: Reassemble the embedded Metal shader when it changes.

patches.author: Paul Adenot
patches.subject: Fall back to the general mat-vec kernel when Metal lacks the _short one.

features.summary: The bundled llama.cpp inference engine now avoids using Apple Metal in the content process, where that GPU path isn’t supported, and falls back to a general-purpose calculation when a specialized Metal kernel is unavailable. Its embedded Metal shader is also rebuilt when it changes, and the build now accounts for all required about:license notices.

features.label: Inference library build

patches.author: Paul Adenot
patches.subject: End an utterance when the decoder stops emitting tokens.

patches.author: Paul Adenot
patches.subject: Emit one SpeechRecognition final result per utterance.

patches.author: Paul Adenot
patches.subject: Report the speech recognition model's memory in about:memory.

features.summary: Speech recognition now ends an utterance when its model stops producing tokens and emits one final result for each utterance, making the results clearer and more consistent. Firefox’s `about:memory` page also reports how much memory the speech recognition model uses.

features.label: ML IPC

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Part 1: Add TextGenerator, WebIDL surface over PTextGeneration

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Part 3: Add HWInferenceProcess and the browser HWInference process

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Part 1: Manage PHWInference under PUtilityProcess

features.summary: Firefox now has a WebIDL interface for text generation, backed by inter-process communication (IPC) to an HWInference process hosted by the browser. This gives machine-learning inference a dedicated process to run in, rather than keeping that work in the page or main browser process.

features.label: ML inference backends

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Part 1: Make LlamaRuntimeLinker::Init thread-safe

patches.author: Joe Bowser
patches.subject: Report when a cancelled llama.cpp generation has released the backend

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Fixed LlamaGenerateTask state update to happen before it notifies stream consumer

features.summary: The llama.cpp inference backend is safer when initialized from multiple threads, and it now reports when a cancelled text-generation request has fully released the backend. Updates to generation state are also delivered before consumers are notified, helping prevent them from seeing stale state.

features.label: Native text generation

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Part 3: Add profiler markers to llama.cpp operations in HWInference

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Implement PTextGeneration with LlamaBackend

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Add PTextGeneration over the browser HWInference process

features.summary: Text generation using llama.cpp is now implemented through the browser’s HWInference process, with IPC carrying requests to the llama.cpp backend. Profiler markers were also added so developers can see how long llama.cpp operations take when investigating performance.

features.label: ML actors

patches.author: Joe Bowser
patches.subject: End the run when a runWithGenerator consumer abandons the generator

patches.author: Joe Bowser
patches.subject: Record engine_run for an abandoned runWithGenerator run

features.summary: A text-generation run now ends if the consumer stops using its generator, rather than continuing work without anyone to receive the result. Firefox also records this abandoned run in its engine telemetry, making this behavior visible in diagnostics.

features.label: Page extractor tests

patches.author: Florian Quèze
patches.subject: Re-enable tests disabled on macOS 15 AArch64 that pass there on try.

patches.author: Taimur Hasan
patches.subject: Follow redirects within the requested site, and match it by registrable domain

features.summary: Page extraction now follows redirects within the requested site, matching sites by their registrable domain (the shared part such as example.com), and tests that behavior. Tests that had been disabled on some newer Macs were also turned back on after passing there.

features.label: ML inference engine

patches.author: Paul Adenot
patches.subject: Attribute MLModelHubService downloads to the requesting task.

features.summary: Downloads from MLModelHubService are now attributed to the task that requested them, making it clearer which feature or task caused a model download.

features.label: ML inference engine docs

patches.author: Paul Adenot
patches.subject: Select the speech recognition model from the locales it declares.

features.summary: Speech recognition now chooses an on-device model based on the languages the model says it supports. This helps Firefox select a suitable model for the requested language.

features.label: ONNX inference DOM API

patches.author: Ryan VanderMeulen
patches.subject: Update onnxruntime toolchain to v1.30.0.

features.summary: Firefox’s ONNX Runtime inference library is updated to version 1.30.0, bringing the ONNX machine-learning runtime and its build toolchain up to date.

features.label: Other

patches.author: Mark Banner
patches.subject: Rename browser/base/content/test general, about, webrtc, popups and tabPrompts directories to match eslint-test-paths conventions

features.summary: Firefox’s browser test folders were renamed to follow the project’s ESLint test-path naming rules. This is an organizational change for development and testing, with no visible browser behavior change.

features.label: Page extractor docs

patches.author: Taimur Hasan
patches.subject: Add Page Extractor developer documentation

features.summary: New developer documentation explains how to use Firefox’s Page Extractor. It gives developers guidance for working with the feature without needing to piece together its behavior from the code.

features.label: ggml tensor library

patches.author: Paul Adenot
patches.subject: Vendor the Metal backend at the pinned llama.cpp revision.

features.summary: The ggml tensor library now includes the Metal backend from the pinned llama.cpp revision, allowing compatible model calculations to run on Apple GPUs.
